text:
You want to speed up manga scene drafting by turning your rough ideas into polished, manga-oriented text without using AI-generated content.

I can help streamline that process with careful, human-written scene drafting and rewriting from your outlines, keeping the tone, pacing, and dialogue natural for manga storytelling. I’ve spent 6 years working with Python, NLP, and language-model workflows, and I’ve also built a LoRA-tuned Flan-T5 system for Brightwell Clinics that drafted visit summaries after names, dates, and IDs were masked, reaching ROUGE-L 0.41 and cutting clinician editing time by 38% in a 6-week trial.

For your project, I’d focus on converting your scene notes into clean, engaging manga-ready prose while preserving your creative vision and style.
